AC-AMENDMENT (gap-analysis):
1. BRIDGE_ALERT for cursor alerts: tests must assert write_cursor_bridge_alert writes a file to tracker_path/__bridge__/ directory, NOT using write_bridge_alert (which needs ticket_id).
2. Cold-start alert reason must differ from malformed-JSON alert reason in the BRIDGE_ALERT payload (so operators can distinguish). Test assertions must check the 'reason' field.
3. 500-commit cap test: cap is checked AFTER --unshallow fetch succeeds. Use a real git fixture with >500 commits OR mock the git log output to return >500 entries.
